name: Renovating KC Design + Remodel

gbp_reviews_visible.text: We highly recommend Renovating KC. Everything about our kitchen/first floor remodel was a positive experience. Their designers, contractors & our Construction Manager Nick kept our project on time, on budget & gave us a new Kitchen & living space we absolutely love. We will definitely have Renovating KC back for our second floor remodel.
